root.label: Phoenix Species Project announces $200 million wildlife fund

events.label: Phoenix Species Project announces $200 million wildlife fund

slots.name: fund amount
slots.sentence: A new fund called the Phoenix Species Project said it would pump $200 million into efforts to pull these animals and plants back from the brink of extinction and even restore them in the wild.

slots.name: species count
slots.sentence: The hundred species were chosen because they were near extinction, had local organizations already working to save them and represent a diversity of habitats, countries and types of species.

slots.name: invertebrate count
slots.sentence: Still, it includes only three invertebrates, among them a snail in Tahiti, and no insects.

slots.name: IUCN critical count
slots.sentence: More than 11,000 species are classified as either critically endangered or extinct in the wild on the I.U.C.N. Red List, the leading global scientific authority on the status of species.

slots.name: IUCN endangered count
slots.sentence: Almost 40,000 more are endangered or vulnerable.

slots.name: Fortune rank
slots.sentence: Last week, it reached No. 1 on the Fortune Global 500 list of the largest companies.
